== Time Requisition ==
[[File:Time Requisition.png|thumb|right|upright|420px|Time Requisition]]
Give this requisition form to the foreman to increase the total amount of time extensions you can purchase. You are normally limited to 9 or +27 minutes, this allows up to 10, or +30 minutes total. Only usable once per party per challenge.

* Acquired by:
** {{Verified|Killing boss monsters in any challenge. (~4-5% chance for them to drop a random challenge item)}}, {{Bind|BtC}}.
** Purchase from the [[DDOstore/Gear and Equipment#Challenge Tools|DDO Store]], {{Bind|BtA}}.

* Only usable once per party per challenge.

* Usable in the following crystal collection challenges:
'''Extraplanar Mining:'''
* [[Extraplanar Palace: Buying Time| Buying Time]]
* [[Extraplanar Palace: Buying Time - EPIC| Buying Time - EPIC]]
'''Lava Caves:'''
* [[Lava Caves: Time is Money|Time is Money]]
* [[Lava Caves: Time is Money - EPIC|Time is Money - EPIC]]
